title: Ministerial stand-ins confirmed by Saeima
summary_full: The Saeima on Friday, November 20, approved so-called "soft" mandates for nine parliamentarians who will serve as members of the Saeima while those politicians originally elected by the Saeima will take up positions as ministers.
